name: High Season
summary: Fill the promenade before the summer crowds leave.
briefing: The Ember Coast lives from its promenade. Shops, restaurants and bars fill up with visitors, but cooling costs bite in the heat. Earn a daily profit of $15,000 and let 20 units within 20 days.

events.message: A heatwave settles over the coast
Festival week: shops and restaurants want in
